DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL server (defaults to localhost if not specified)

PG_PORT.description: Port number of the PostgreSQL server (default: 5432)

PG_DATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name for Keycloak (e.g., keycloak)

PG_USERNAME.description: Username used to connect to the PostgreSQL database

PG_PASSWORD.description: Password for connecting to the PostgreSQL database

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username for Keycloak master realm (used only on first startup)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password for Keycloak master realm (used only on first startup)

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge for Railway TLS termination, passthrough, or reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable plain HTTP listener; set false for HTTPS-only in most Railway deployments

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public URL for accessing Keycloak; must match Railway or custom domain

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
